configuration.name: Action timeout
configuration.description: Maximum seconds to wait for queued Chime TTS work.

configuration.name: TTS generation timeout
configuration.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a TTS platform response. Use -1 to disable this timeout.

configuration.name: Default TTS platform
configuration.description: Used when an action does not specify a TTS platform.

configuration.name: Fallback TTS platform
configuration.description: Used when the requested TTS platform is unavailable.

configuration.name: Default language
configuration.description: Applied with the default TTS platform when supported.

configuration.name: Default voice
configuration.description: Applied with the default TTS platform when supported.

configuration.name: Default dialect
configuration.description: Google Translate dialect fallback.

configuration.name: Default start chime
configuration.description: Optional chime played before generated speech.

configuration.name: Default end chime
configuration.description: Optional chime played after generated speech.

configuration.name: Default offset
configuration.description: Milliseconds between chimes and TTS; negative values overlay audio.

configuration.name: Default crossfade
configuration.description: Milliseconds to fade one audio segment out while the next fades in.

configuration.name: Fade transition
configuration.description: Milliseconds used for announce and fade_audio transitions.

configuration.name: Temporary-file cleanup delay
configuration.description: Milliseconds to wait before deleting uncached temporary files.

configuration.name: Add cover art
configuration.description: Embed Chime TTS cover art in generated MP3 files.

configuration.name: Custom chimes folder
configuration.description: Folder containing your own chimes. Changes require a Home Assistant restart.

configuration.name: Downloaded chimes folder
configuration.description: Where downloaded chime files are cached.

configuration.name: Temporary audio folder
configuration.description: Generated-audio folder; it must be inside a configured media directory.

configuration.name: say_url output folder
configuration.description: Generated public-audio folder; it must be allowlisted, /media, or /config/www.

configuration.name: Default pre-playback script
configuration.description: Runs before playback unless an action or profile overrides it.

configuration.name: Default post-playback script
configuration.description: Runs after playback unless an action or profile overrides it.

notifyProfiles.name: Media players
notifyProfiles.description: Required target media player or list of media players.

notifyProfiles.name: TTS platform, language, voice and TLD
notifyProfiles.description: Provider selection and supported provider defaults.

notifyProfiles.name: Timing and TTS tuning
notifyProfiles.description: offset, crossfade, final_delay, tts_speed and tts_pitch.

notifyProfiles.name: Playback and audio options
notifyProfiles.description: volume_level, audio_conversion, options, announce, fade_audio, cache, join_players and unjoin_players.

notifyProfiles.name: Playback scripts
notifyProfiles.description: pre_script and post_script accept a script entity or YAML with script and data.
